'''Aelon Reglis''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] and family man from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].

==Biography==
Aelon Reglis was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] from the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Wanting to live adventures among the stars, he bought the [[Adventurer (Crescent-class)|''Adventurer'']], a [[Crescent-class Transport|''Crescent''-class transport]] Mark II built by [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]]. Soon after making the purchase, Reglis met a bureaucrat from Chandrila, fell in love with her, married her and had a child, [[Lynx Reglis|Lynx]]. Reglis settled and, during the weekends, he sat on his parked ship to daydream.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Lynx Reglis eventually graduated in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Aelon gave her the ''Adventurer'' as a present, hoping she could get more profit from the ship that he did.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
